summary: Lotus Technology Inc. (Nasdaq: LOT) filed a Form 6-K on August 25, 2026, announcing the completed acquisition of 100% equity interest in Lotus Advance Technologies Sdn Bhd (Lotus UK) on August 21, 2026. The transaction followed the exercise of put options by Geely and Etika, the sellers. Financial terms were not disclosed. Lotus UK, based in Hethel, Norfolk, adds sports car manufacturing and engineering consultancy capabilities, unifying all operations under 'One Lotus' as part of the Focus 2030 strategy. No board recommendation or advisors were named. The integration aims to streamline governance and enhance synergies across R&D, supply chain, and sales. Watch for operational integration milestones and potential cost savings realization.
